title: Prologue
description: Winter robbery in Ludendorff (North Yankton), set nine years earlier. Michael, Trevor and Brad break into a Bobcat Security vault. The escape through the snow goes wrong after a collision with a train and police intervention, ending with the secret pact between Michael and federal agent Dave Norton to fake his own death.
goldRequirements: Shoot at least 12 police officers in the head
reward: Unlocks Los Santos and Franklin

title: Franklin and Lamar
description: First job for Simeon Yetarian's dealership. Franklin and Lamar go to a villa in Rockford Hills to recover two high-end sports cars. They race at full speed through the streets of Los Santos, weaving through traffic and shaking off patrol cars before parking the vehicles at Premium Deluxe Motorsport.
goldRequirements: Finish the race without seriously damaging the 9F
Use Franklin's special ability for at least 7 seconds
Avoid collisions in the studio parking lot

title: Repossession
description: Repossession job in the alleys of Vespucci Beach. Franklin and Lamar try to recover a motorcycle on Vagos gang turf. Negotiations collapse abruptly, sparking a shootout among the garages and an immediate chase on foot and down the road to catch the target.
goldRequirements: Shoot the gasoline trail to blow up the vehicle
reward: Experience and Simeon's respect

title: Complications
description: Stealth infiltration of the De Santa residence in Rockford Hills. Franklin must get past the staff to steal Jimmy's SUV. The operation takes an unexpected turn when Michael appears armed in the back seat and demands he drive straight through the window of Simeon's business.
goldRequirements: Take no damage during the fistfight with Simeon
reward: $300 and Michael as a playable character

title: Chop
description: Attempted quick abduction of a Ballas ringleader nicknamed 'D'. Lamar and Franklin chase the suspect to the rail yards. With the nose and help of Chop the Rottweiler, they search the freight cars until they run the fugitive down.
goldRequirements: See the world from Chop's perspective for 10 seconds
Use Franklin's driving ability for 7 seconds
reward: Chop as Franklin's companion

title: Father/Son
description: A failed online sale ends with Michael's family boat stolen on the freeway with Jimmy aboard. Michael and Franklin set off on a desperate chase in Amanda's sports car, and Franklin must jump onto the moving trailer to bring the young man to safety.
goldRequirements: Rescue Jimmy within 10 seconds of him hanging from the boom
Return Amanda's car to Los Santos Customs with no further damage
reward: Unlocks free Los Santos Customs upgrades for Franklin

title: Marriage Counseling
description: After discovering an affair in his home, Michael and Franklin chase the tennis coach to a huge property in Vinewood Hills. Driven by rage, Michael uses a pickup truck to pull down the terrace, only to learn that it belongs to cartel boss Martin Madrazo, who demands multimillion-dollar compensation.
goldRequirements: Complete with minimal damage to the pickup truck
reward: $2,500,000 debt to Martin Madrazo

title: Daddy's Little Girl
description: A family bike ride between Vespucci and Del Perro Pier goes wrong on discovering that Tracey is on a private boat in shady company. Michael jumps into the water and uses a Seashark to extract his daughter and flee through the canals, dodging gunfire.
goldRequirements: Reach top speed on the Seashark
Don't fall off the bike during the race
Swim to the yacht in under 1 minute
reward: Physical stamina upgrade for Michael

title: Friend Request
description: Michael turns to the brilliant mind of Lester Crest to pay off the debt to Madrazo. As a preliminary favor, he sneaks into the headquarters of tech company Lifeinvader posing as an IT worker to rig a device that CEO Jay Norris will show during a live-streamed presentation.
goldRequirements: Clear all pop-ups in under 32 seconds
reward: Lester agrees to help with the heists

title: The Long Stretch
description: A deal at the Rogers Waste treatment plant with Lamar and Stretch. It turns out to be an ambush set up by the Ballas, forcing the group to clear corridors under crossfire and neutralize police air surveillance to get out of the neighborhood.
goldRequirements: Complete with minimal damage to Franklin
reward: Weapons and ammo obtained during the escape

title: Casing the Jewel Store
description: Tactical reconnaissance at the Vangelico jewelry store in Rockford Hills. Equipped with a hidden micro-camera, Michael documents ventilation grilles, sensors and alarm terminals. Later, at Lester's warehouse, the robbery tactic is chosen: a stealth raid with sleeping gas or a frontal assault with brute force.
goldRequirements: Photograph all 3 security systems in one perfect shot
reward: Planning board for the Vangelico heist

title: Bugstars Equipment
description: Steal a pest control van (Bugstars) at the port to use as a Trojan horse during the Vangelico robbery.
goldRequirements: Steal the Bugstars van without being detected
reward: Van and disguises secured for the heist (Smart approach).

title: BZ Gas Grenades
description: Intercept a Humane Labs truck carrying BZ nerve gas and secure the cargo for the jewelry store robbery.
goldRequirements: Shoot the truck's rear doors so the cargo falls out
reward: BZ gas secured to neutralize civilians in the heist (Smart approach).

title: The Jewel Store Job
description: Timed robbery of the Vangelico store. The crew clears the display cases before the police are alerted and escapes on dirt bikes through the underground tram tunnels to the river channel, where a heavy vehicle sweeps the patrol cars aside to secure the getaway.
goldRequirements: Rob the display cases in under 50 seconds
Protect Franklin during the Los Santos River chase
Clear all 20 jewelry cases without leaving any loot behind
reward: Million-dollar take (approx. $200,000 for Franklin and $1,200,000 for Michael)

title: Mr. Philips
description: A phrase broadcast on the news reveals to Trevor Philips that Michael survived North Yankton. Unleashing his rage in the Sandy Shores desert, he wipes out The Lost bikers' base of operations in Grapeseed and destroys Ortega's riverside camp.
goldRequirements: Cause massive damage to Ortega's trailer
reward: Trevor unlocked as the third playable protagonist

title: Trevor Philips Industries
description: A business negotiation with the triads' envoy in Blaine County is interrupted by an armed attack from the O'Neil brothers. Trevor shelters the buyers in the liquor store's cold room and fights off waves of attackers from the roof and windows of the lab.
reward: Consolidated control of the business in Sandy Shores

title: Nervous Ron
description: Armed retaliation after the sabotage of Trevor's home. With tactical support from Ron atop a water tank, they take McKenzie airfield, seize cargo aircraft and take out enemy vehicles while flying over the county's bridges.
goldRequirements: Get 5 headshots with a sniper rifle
Fly under 6 bridges during the flight
Kill all the bikers while standing on the wing of the plane
reward: McKenzie Field hangar available for purchase

title: Crystal Maze
description: Punitive attack on the O'Neil brothers' farm after losing the exclusive deal with the Asian investors. Trevor eliminates the shooters posted in the hills, clears the house and pours fuel in the basement to burn the place to ashes.
goldRequirements: Complete without being detected before entering the house
Ignite the gasoline trail with a single bullet
reward: Competition in the county eliminated

title: Friends Reunited
description: Departure for Los Santos to track down Michael. Trevor leaves his mark by blowing up the bikers' trailer park with sticky bombs and sets off on a road trip with Wade, ending by forcing his way into Floyd's apartment in Vespucci.
goldRequirements: Get 5 headshots with explosives or a sniper rifle
Destroy all the trailers without alerting reinforcements
Complete with minimal damage to the Bodhi
reward: Floyd's safehouse in Vespucci unlocked

title: Fame or Shame
description: The face-to-face reunion between Michael and Trevor is overshadowed when they learn about Tracey's audition for the TV contest Fame or Shame. They rush to the Maze Bank Arena, stop the taping and corner host Lazlow Jones after a truck chase along the urban riverbed.
goldRequirements: Reach top speed in the Phantom truck
Don't detach the trailer during the chase
Don't harm pedestrians on the set
reward: Initial reconciliation between Michael and Trevor

title: Dead Man Walking
description: Dave Norton forces Michael to work for the FIB, blackmailing him over his return to crime. Wake up inside the morgue after faking death, find Ferdinand Kerimov's credentials and escape the facility under siege by the IAA.
goldRequirements: Kill 4 enemies using the special ability
reward: Unlocks missions for the FIB.

title: Three's Company
description: Joint rescue operation with all three characters in Downtown. Under FIB orders, Trevor flies the helicopter, Michael rappels down the windows of the IAA building to burst into the interrogation and Franklin assists by eliminating threats with a sniper rifle from a nearby rooftop.
reward: Unlocks joint FIB missions

title: By the Book
description: Interrogation at the Los Santos docks under the supervision of agents Steve Haines and Dave Norton. As information on the suspect comes out, Michael watches a private party in the Chumash hills to identify and take down the target without raising suspicion.
goldRequirements: Don't stop Kerimov's heart during the interrogation
Use all 4 torture tools at least once
Shoot the correct target on the first try without hesitating
reward: Trevor takes Kerimov safely to the airport

title: Hood Safari
description: A shady deal in the heart of Grove Street with Lamar and Trevor. The goods turn out to be a con, sparking close-quarters urban combat against local gang members and a getaway on jet skis through the storm drains.
reward: $0 (failed deal)

title: Did Somebody Say Yoga?
description: Endure a yoga session with instructor Fabien, deal with Jimmy's betrayal and try to survive a bad anesthetic trip.
goldRequirements: Complete each of the 3 yoga poses without mistakes
reward: Amanda, Jimmy and Tracey leave the house. Michael temporarily loses access to his personal vehicles.

title: Scouting the Port
description: Trevor pressures Wade and his cousin Floyd (a dock worker) into organizing a paramilitary-scale robbery. Infiltrate the port facilities run by Merryweather Security, disguised as a dock worker, to locate an advanced technology device and plan its theft.
goldRequirements: Complete the dock worker section without damaging the containers
Take the photos of the ship correctly on the first try
Finish all the dock work without causing altercations
reward: Unlocks the setup missions for the Merryweather Heist.

title: Minisub
description: Steal an experimental minisub from a survey ship docked at the port. It is required regardless of the approach chosen for the Merryweather Heist.
goldRequirements: Steal the submarine without boarding the civilian ship
reward: Submarine secured for either heist approach.

title: Cargobob
description: Infiltrate the maximum-security military base (Fort Zancudo) and steal a heavy military transport helicopter (Cargobob) capable of lifting the minisub.
reward: Cargo helicopter secured for the Offshore approach.

title: The Merryweather Heist
description: Operation against the convoys of the Merryweather military corporation. Using a submersible and a heavy-lift helicopter, the team recovers a military device sunk in deep water, which must ultimately be returned on Lester's orders to avoid government reprisals.
goldRequirements: Find the underwater device in under 02:00
Take out the pursuing helicopters without taking critical damage
reward: Experience (device returned with no immediate payment)

title: Trash Truck
description: Locate and steal an active garbage truck from the municipal fleet ('Trashmaster') to serve as a heavy roadblock for ambushing the armored truck in the heist.
reward: Blocking vehicle secured for 'Blitz Play'.

title: Tow Truck
description: Steal a tow truck to be used to pull off the rear doors of the armored truck during the 'Blitz Play' operation.
reward: Getaway/ramming vehicle secured for 'Blitz Play'.

title: Blitz Play
description: Tactical robbery of an armored truck in the Cypress Flats industrial zone. The road is cut off with a heavy vehicle, the truck is disabled with a tow truck and the doors are blown open with explosives, holding back the tactical units until reaching the transfer point.
goldRequirements: Shoot down the helicopter as Trevor
reward: Secret funds for the FIB operation

title: Mr. Richards
description: Intimidate the lead actor and the director of Solomon Richards' latest film into returning to the shoot, using reckless flying tactics.
goldRequirements: Take no damage during the fight
Land the helicopter without damaging it
reward: The film collaboration between Michael and Solomon begins.

title: I Fought the Law...
description: A special assignment from tycoon Devin Weston to seize two exotic vehicles. Posing as traffic officers on patrol motorcycles, Michael and Trevor intercept the drivers on the coastal highway and race each other to deliver them to the agreed garage.
goldRequirements: Drive between two trucks at the same time
Win the race on the police bike without crashing
reward: Devin Weston as a new employer

title: Eye in the Sky
description: Scan the residential districts using the advanced thermal sensors and facial recognition of a police helicopter to steal a valuable Z-Type (a hyper-luxury classic car).
goldRequirements: Find the target on the first opportunity
Deliver the Z-Type without a single scratch
reward: Unlocks more cars from Devin's list.

title: Caida Libre
description: Kill Martin Madrazo's cousin (Javier) by shooting down his private jet in mid-flight with heavy artillery and recover some incriminating documents.
goldRequirements: Reach top speed on the Sanchez bike
Don't fall off the Sanchez during the chase
Shoot down the plane with 3 shots
reward: Michael and Trevor are exiled from Los Santos. Unlocks the Sandy Shores safehouse.

title: Deep Inside
description: Infiltrate a film shoot and steal a modified Aston Martin-style car (Dewbauchee JB 700) equipped with real weapons and spy gadgets.
goldRequirements: Deliver the JB 700 with minimal damage
Reach top speed in the JB 700
Eject the passenger in under 10 seconds
reward: New delivery for Devin Weston's garage.

title: Minor Turbulence
description: Board a Merryweather cargo plane in mid-flight, take control of the aircraft and survive the counterattack by fighter jets from the military base.
goldRequirements: Leave the cargo plane driving the Mesa SUV
reward: None. All the cargo sinks into Alamo Sea.

title: Paleto Score Setup
description: The first joint plan designed directly by Lester and Trevor from the trailer. Scout and trigger the alarm at the rural Paleto Bay bank to measure the tactical response of the local police.
goldRequirements: Drive to the bank in under 03:30
Win the race back to the lab
reward: Preparations for the Paleto Score begin.

title: Predator
description: Hunt down and wipe out the surviving O'Neil brothers hiding in the dense Raton Canyon forest.
reward: None. Revenge and elimination of the remaining O'Neil brothers.

title: Military Hardware
description: Ambush a military convoy to steal a truck carrying full-body bulletproof military suits and rotary machine guns (Miniguns).
goldRequirements: Stop the convoy using a sticky bomb
reward: Armor and heavy weapons secured for the Paleto Score.

title: The Paleto Score
description: Armed assault on the Paleto Bay bank with heavy weapons and full-body ballistic suits. The team holds out against a joint cordon of special forces and military until Franklin arrives with heavy machinery to clear a path to the train tracks.
goldRequirements: Cause more than $1,000,000 in property damage to Paleto Bay
reward: Approx. $450,000 net for each character

title: Derailed
description: Boarding a moving train by motorcycle to force a collision on the Zancudo River bridge. With the cars plunged into the water, Michael reaches them by boat to extract the cargo while they fight off Merryweather's tactical forces.
goldRequirements: Land on the train car with the bike on the first try
Reach top speed with the speedboat
reward: High-value contraband artifacts

title: Monkey Business
description: Infiltrate the high-security Humane Labs facility through the water ducts to steal an experimental nerve toxin for the FIB.
reward: The deal with Haines is settled. Madrazo stops the pursuit.

title: Hang Ten
description: With the situation at the safehouse unsustainable and tension among the protagonists, Trevor needs a new independent base to plan the 'Big Score'. Bring Trevor's relationship with Floyd and Debra to a violent end and take over a new headquarters in Los Santos by force.
reward: Trevor takes control of the Vanilla Unicorn strip club, which becomes his safehouse in LS.

title: Surveying the Score
description: Carry out a vulnerability analysis, measure response times and locate access points at the Union Depository.
goldRequirements: Follow the armored trucks without being warned about the distance
Find the construction hole in under 20 seconds
Fly under the bridge while tracking the trucks and go through a tunnel
reward: Official Big Score planning (Subtle or Obvious).

title: Bury the Hatchet
description: Travel to snowy Ludendorff (North Yankton) to dig up the grave of 'Michael Townley' and survive an ambush by Wei Cheng's cartel.
reward: Temporary crew split; Trevor discovers the truth about Brad.

title: Pack Man
description: Transport the batch of stolen luxury hypercars on a car carrier ('Packer') to the drop-off point in Paleto Bay, evading an LSPD chase.
goldRequirements: Deliver the JB 700 with minimal damage
Destroy 3 police cars using the spikes
reward: None. Weston refuses to pay the protagonists.

title: Fresh Meat
description: Track the signal from Michael's phone, storm a meat processing plant (Raven Abattoir) and slaughter the Triads to save his life.
goldRequirements: Switch characters no more than 3 times
reward: Michael is rescued and contact with Lester resumes.

title: The Ballad of Rocco
description: Take out Rocco Pelosi (the Liberty City mobster) for good after he physically assaulted Solomon Richards at the film studios.
reward: Michael is credited as Associate Producer on Solomon's film.

title: Cleaning out the Bureau
description: Track down and obtain the uniforms and ID cards of the FIB cleaning staff in order to infiltrate the building and erase Steve Haines' incriminating files.
goldRequirements: Check all the license plates in the parking lot
Follow the janitor without being detected
reward: Official planning of the FIB raid.

title: Reuniting the Family
description: Bring Amanda, Tracey and Jimmy back together after months of separation, dealing with their respective problems to rebuild the family.
reward: The De Santa family returns to the mansion. The family vehicles are available again.

title: Architect's Plans
description: Steal the architectural plans of the FIB building from the lead architect of the expansion project to find gaps in its security.
goldRequirements: Leave the construction area within 45 seconds of stealing the briefcase
reward: Building plans secured for the FIB raid.

title: Legal Trouble
description: Stop billionaire Devin Weston and his lawyers, who have stolen the only original reel of the film to collect the insurance and ruin Solomon.
goldRequirements: Lose your wanted level in under 2 minutes
Watch the news camera (Weazel News) for 15 seconds
reward: Threat to the film 'Meltdown' eliminated.

title: The Bureau Raid
description: Direct raid on FIB headquarters to erase classified records. Depending on the strategy selected, the assault is carried out by parachuting onto the roof or by posing as a fire department evacuation with controlled detonations.
reward: Records erased and legal pressure on Michael lifted

title: The Wrap Up
description: A meeting at the Kortz Center turns into a three-way shootout between rival factions of the FIB, the IAA and private troops. Michael is surrounded on the museum terraces until Trevor appears just in time from high ground.
goldRequirements: Shoot down the pursuing helicopter with a sniper rifle
reward: Dave Norton and Michael survive

title: Lamar Down
description: Rescue operation at the Paleto Forest sawmill to free Lamar from an ambush. Franklin brings Michael and Trevor together to coordinate an enveloping assault on the sawmill and neutralize the captors before they can get away.
goldRequirements: Rescue Lamar without him losing more than a third of his health
reward: Lamar's unbreakable friendship

title: Meltdown
description: The film premiere in Vinewood is cut short by Devin Weston's threat against the De Santas. Michael rushes home to fight off the mercenaries and keep Amanda and Tracey safe inside the mansion.
goldRequirements: Reach top speed in the vehicle during the race to the mansion
reward: Full reconciliation of the De Santa family

title: Driller
description: Steal a heavy transport truck carrying a giant tunnel boring machine. It is required to drill through the vault in the Obvious approach.
goldRequirements: Steal the tunnel boring machine without being detected
reward: Tunnel boring machine (Cutter) secured for the Obvious approach.

title: Sidetracked
description: Hijack a flatbed freight train to load the stolen gold bars and transport them to the air extraction point. Exclusive to the Obvious approach.
goldRequirements: Steal the train without being discovered
reward: Stolen freight cars to move the gold in the Obvious approach.

title: The Big Score
description: The ultimate assault on the Union Depository to steal the most heavily protected gold reserve in the country. It can be carried out either with a subtle maneuver using fake transports and a traffic hack, or with a frontal underground drilling operation and air extraction.
goldRequirements: Drop the gold onto the train with pinpoint accuracy
reward: Approx. $28,000,000 for each of the three protagonists

title: The Hotel Assassination
description: A hit ordered by Lester to influence the stock market. Franklin takes up position opposite the Von Crastenburg hotel in Rockford Hills and takes out the Bilkinton Research executive before his entourage leaves.
goldRequirements: Kill the target with a sniper rifle
Money earned by investing in Betta Pharmaceuticals beforehand
reward: $9,000 + huge stock market profits

title: The Multi Target Assassination
description: Kill 4 corrupt jurors bought by the Redwood tobacco company before they deliver their verdict.
goldRequirements: Finish all the assassinations as quickly as possible
reward: Debonaire (DEB) shares soar on the LCN.

title: The Vice Assassination
description: Kill Jackson Skinner, head of Facade's technology department, who sells confidential information to competitors in the red-light district.
goldRequirements: Escape the scene without alerting the police
reward: Fruit Computers (FRT) shares will rise 50% on BAWSAQ.

title: The Bus Assassination
description: Kill Isaac Penny, a greedy billionaire speculator, while he rides his usual public transport route.
goldRequirements: Run over the target and flee
reward: Manipulation of Vapid Motor Company shares.

title: The Construction Assassination
description: Kill real estate crime boss Enzo Bonelli, who is hiding on the upper floors of a skyscraper under construction guarded by private security.
reward: Manipulation of GoldCoast (GCD) shares on the LCN.

title: Option A: Something Sensible
description: An ending forced by the federal agency to neutralize Trevor. Franklin arranges a meeting that ends in a chase to the oil fields of El Burro Heights, where a collision with a flammable tank seals the target's fate.
reward: The take is split between Franklin and Michael (Trevor is gone)

title: Option B: The Time's Come
description: An ending under pressure from Devin Weston to get rid of Michael. The confrontation moves to the heights of a steel foundry and ends with a struggle on the metal walkways that sends Michael falling to his death.
reward: The take is split between Franklin and Trevor (Michael is gone)

title: Option C: The Third Way
description: The canonical conclusion in which the three protagonists team up to settle old scores. After holding out against the siege at the foundry, they split up the targets to eliminate their pursuers from the FIB, the triads and rival gangs, ending with the kidnapping of Devin Weston and his car going over a cliff on the coast.
goldRequirements: Kill Cheng with a sticky bomb
Kill Steve Haines with a headshot
reward: $28,000,000 for each and all three characters alive and playable
